description: What to eat for a health goal — the nutrients involved, why each one, and which raw recipes carry them — the "what should I eat for X" question. Accepts a goal ("gut health", "bone-health") or a named condition ("PCOS", "ADHD", "anaemia"): condition names resolve even though topic titles are physiological. Topics often looked up alongside a diagnosis include a note on what the evidence does and does not support, with its own evidence rating; for ADHD and autism the note states that diet is not a treatment, per NICE. Omit the argument to list every topic.

include_recipes.description: Include raw recipes carrying this goal. Default true.

topic.description: Goal slug or title, or a condition name — e.g. "digestion-gut", "PCOS", "anaemia". Omit to list all topics.

name: health_topic
title: Eat for a health goal
